Shared packages and repo tooling are done. Typecheck, lint, test (tokens 82 tests, shared 56) and build pass for both packages. Workspace-wide typecheck and lint also pass, including @gp/contracts. Nothing is committed.

FOR WEB/API AGENTS:
- dist/ is git-ignored. Run 'pnpm build:packages' (builds only tokens and shared) after install, or whenever you change them. Install with 'flock /tmp/gp-pnpm.lock pnpm install'.
- Pinned versions: TypeScript ~5.9.3 (typescript-eslint does not support TS 7), ESLint ^9.39.5 (eslint-config-next@15 does not accept ESLint 10), zod ^4.6.7 (zod 4 API: { error }, z.uuid(), z.iso.datetime()), vitest ^4.1.12, tsup ^8.5.1, decimal.js ^10.6, viem ^2.58.
- ESLint, per package: import { createConfig } from '../../eslint.config.mjs'; export default createConfig({ tsconfigRootDir: import.meta.dirname, typeChecked: true, extra: [...] }). Root also has prettier.config.mjs and tsconfig.base.json (strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, Bundler resolution); Nest can override module settings.
- Web CSS imports, in this order: @import 'tailwindcss'; then '@gp/tokens/tokens.css', '@gp/tokens/theme.css', '@gp/tokens/text-styles.css'.
- theme.css removes Tailwind's default palette, so bg-white and bg-slate-500 do not exist. Use token classes: bg-bg-base, bg-surface-default/raised, text-text-primary/secondary/tertiary, border-border-default, bg-brand with text-text-on-primary, text-gold, bg-status-*-tint, text-balance-*, rounded-xs..2xl (rounded-lg = 14px), p-4 (spacing base 4px), w-sidebar, h-topbar, max-w-desktop, shadow-elevation-1..4, shadow-focus-ring, ease-standard, bg-gradient-gold-jackpot, text-h1 / text-number-m, and breakpoints tablet: / laptop: / desktop:.
- shadcn slots (background, foreground, primary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, card, popover) are already mapped to tokens.
- Fonts: override --gp-font-sans / --gp-font-mono on :root (for example with next/font variables). Defaults are 'Inter Variable' and 'Geist Mono'.
- @gp/tokens JS exports: tokens, colors (resolved hex keyed like 'bg-base'), primitiveColors, cssVar().
- @gp/shared (ESM + CJS + d.ts). Sub-paths: /money /fees /pool /chains /enums /limits /format /schemas /types /demo.
  - money: parseUSDT, toUSDTString ('351.75'; at least 2 dp, at most 6 dp; throws above 6 dp), formatUSDT ('1,234.50 USDT'; uses the typographic minus U+2212 and truncates by default), add/sub/mul/sum/percentOf, compare/eq/gt, roundDown, toBaseUnits/fromBaseUnits. JS numbers are accepted only as safe integers; decimals must be strings.
  - fees: entryQuote(n), withdrawalQuote(amount, chain) (also returns meetsMinimum).
  - pool: prizeBreakdown, ROUND_THRESHOLDS, oddsDisclosure.
  - chains: CHAINS / ENABLED_CHAINS (only Arbitrum Sepolia 421614 is enabled).
  - enums: lowercase snake_case values (keep Prisma enums identical), plus WITHDRAWAL_TRANSITIONS, ROLE_PERMISSIONS, PERMISSION_POLICY and LedgerAccountType.
  - schemas: withdrawalRequestSchema, enterRoundSchema, onboardingSchema (= registerSchema), adminLoginSchema (= loginSchema), verifyEmailSchema, totpChallengeSchema, paginationQuerySchema, transactionsQuerySchema, rgLimitUpdateSchema, selfExclusionSchema, errorEnvelopeSchema, makeErrorEnvelope, ERROR_HTTP_STATUS, zodIssues.
  - demo: DEMO aggregate plus DEMO_* exports. Every record has isDemo: true. Ids are deterministic UUIDs that start with de0000 (round #1,248 = de000002-0000-4000-8000-000000001248); the seed should reuse them.
- Dockerfile script contract: apps/api must provide build and start:prod, plus db:migrate:deploy (CI also calls it with if-present). apps/web must provide build and start. API listens on :4000 (/health), web on :3000.

api.report:
I built apps/api (@gp/api), the GLOBAL POOL backend: NestJS 11, Prisma 6, PostgreSQL, Redis/BullMQ, socket.io, with request validation from the @gp/shared zod schemas. Typecheck, lint, test (34 unit + 30 e2e) and build all pass, and the built server boots: /health returns 200 with database and Redis up, /docs serves Swagger UI and /docs-json lists 83 operations. Nothing is committed.

Two things first. Prisma refused `migrate reset` because it detected an AI agent, and I did not bypass that guard. Instead the e2e setup only runs `migrate deploy`. Separately, I made a shell mistake: one command let the shell run backtick text from a markdown string as commands. I stopped it and checked: nothing ran beyond "command not found" errors. .env, the database and the docs were unchanged, and no processes were left running.

What is in apps/api:
- Config: env is validated with zod at boot. The API refuses to start with REAL_MONEY_ENABLED=true, weak secrets or a wrong-size TOTP key.
- HTTP layer: pino logging with request ids and secret redaction, helmet, CORS, rate limiting, a global filter that returns every error in the shared error envelope, and Swagger.
- Data model: 46 tables in prisma/schema.prisma. The init migration adds database triggers that block UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on the ledger, pool_ledger, fee_ledger, audit_logs and withdrawal_events, and reject any posting whose lines do not sum to zero.
- Seed: prisma/seed.ts runs only with DEMO_MODE=true and checks its own totals before finishing.
- Modules (24): auth, security (2FA), users, wallet, deposits, withdrawals, transactions, pool, randomness, games, notifications, compliance, kyc, aml, affiliates (stub), admin, audit, reporting, blockchain, feature-flags, platform, health, ledger, idempotency.
- Background jobs: BullMQ workers for the deposit watcher, withdrawal processing and round settlement; they start only when JOBS_ENABLED=true.
- WebSocket: namespace /pool sends pool:snapshot on connect, pool:update after each entry purchase, and round:status on lifecycle changes.

Key behaviours:
- Ledger: append-only double entry. Balances are always computed from the ledger. Locked = funds held for pending withdrawals + the player's stake in rounds not yet settled.
- Entering a round is one DB transaction with an idempotency key. 35 entries take 351.75 from Available: 350.00 into the round pool (shown as Locked) and 1.75 into fees, never into the pool.
- Winner selection is a bit-for-bit copy of the contract's DrawMath.deriveWinners/splitPool. Unit tests check it against the Solidity-proven vectors in packages/contracts.
- GET /pool/rounds/:number/verify returns the random word and recomputes the winners for comparison.
- No endpoint can set results, pick winners, settle by hand, change balances or edit ledger rows. The e2e tests confirm such paths return 404.

The DEMO seed reconciles exactly. @nova.k has Available 9,215.30, Locked 1,850.00, Pending 1,000.00, Owed 415.20, total 12,480.50. Round #1,248 is open with 3,412 participants, 18,640 entries, a 186,400.00 pool and 932.00 in fees; @nova.k holds E-1248-00981 to 01015. The ledger sums to 0.00.

Commands run (all pass):
- `pnpm --filter @gp/api typecheck`, `lint` and `build`
- `pnpm --filter @gp/api test`: unit 9 files / 34 tests, e2e 3 files / 30 tests against globalpool_test
- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline`: the lockfile matches the manifests
- `prettier --check` on apps/api and the two docs
- `node dist/src/main.js`, then curl /health, /docs, /docs-json and several player and admin endpoints

Endpoints (full table with auth and descriptions in docs/API.md):
- Public: /health, /config, /config/chains, /compliance/region, /games, /games/:slug, /auth/config.
- Pool (public reads): /pool/rounds/current, /pool/rounds, /pool/rounds/:number with /verify and /feed, /pool/winners, /pool/quote.
- Auth: /auth/session, /auth/onboarding, /auth/logout, /auth/dev/token (DEV MOCK only).
- 2FA: /auth/2fa (status), enroll, confirm, challenge, backup-codes, disable, /auth/anti-phishing.
- Users: /me (GET/PATCH), /me/sessions (+ DELETE one), /me/wallets, /me/wallets/whitelist (+ DELETE).
- Wallet: /wallet/balances, /wallet/lifetime, /wallet/owed/claim.
- Deposits: /deposits/address, /deposits.
- Withdrawals: /withdrawals (POST/GET), /withdrawals/quote, /withdrawals/:id, /withdrawals/:id/cancel.
- Entries: POST /pool/rounds/:roundId/entries, GET /pool/rounds/:roundId/my-entries.
- Other player routes: /transactions, /transactions/:reference, /responsible-gaming (+ limits, self-exclusion, reality-check, reality-check/ack), /kyc, /kyc/start, /notifications (+ read, read-all), /referrals/me.
- DEMO only (404 in production): /dev/deposits/simulate, /dev/withdrawals/:id/simulate-confirm, /dev/kyc/approve.
- Admin auth: /admin/auth/login, refresh, logout, me.
- Admin: dashboard, users and users/:id, restrictions (apply and lift), withdrawals queue with approve/reject, approvals, audit-logs and audit-logs/verify, ledger/reconciliation, ledger/balances, rounds (read-only), aml/alerts and resolve, feature-flags, affiliates.

Files outside apps/api, all additive:
- global-pool/pnpm-workspace.yaml: added @prisma/client, @prisma/engines, prisma, argon2 and @swc/core to onlyBuiltDependencies.
- pnpm-lock.yaml: updated for the new dependencies.
- .env.example: appended an "API extras" section.
- docs/API.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: new; ARCHITECTURE.md covers the backend part only.
- global-pool/.env: created from .env.example (git-ignored).
- The vitest config renames to .mts are staged in the git index (`git mv`), not committed.

Dev credentials are in apps/api/.dev/demo-admins.json and demo-player.json (git-ignored, confirmed). A @nova.k token comes from POST /auth/dev/token with did:privy:demo-nova-k.

Not verified, and known gaps:
- Real Privy mode: no app id was available, so only the DEV MOCK was tested. @privy-io/server-auth is deprecated upstream in favour of @privy-io/node; I used it per the owner decision.
- The deposit watcher was never run against a real RPC with test-USDT; only its "skip when unconfigured" path ran. It has no reorg handling.
- ChainlinkVrfProvider was not tested against a deployed GlobalPoolRounds.
- The API does not yet write to the contract (openRound, commitEntries, recordSettlement), and entries do not store the per-entry salts the contract's Merkle tree needs.
- No withdrawal signer is wired: queued withdrawals wait; the DEMO endpoint simulates the confirmation.
- Docker images were not built (no Docker daemon). Prisma on node:22-bookworm-slim probably needs openssl installed.
- docker-compose sets NODE_ENV=production, where the DEV MOCK is refused, so player sign-in is disabled there unless a Privy app id is set.
- Not built yet: game session endpoints, email sending, referral accrual, enforcement of the session-time RG limit, OpenAPI response schemas, a Redis-backed throttler and socket.io adapter for multiple replicas.
- The e2e suite never truncates the test DB, so it grows with every run.
- In the dev database I deleted two rows that my own boot test had created a few minutes earlier (an empty auto-scheduled round #1 and its ledger account) so the seed could run. No other data was touched.

Facts worth remembering, both learned this session: Prisma 6 blocks `migrate reset` for AI agents unless the user gives explicit consent, so agents should use `migrate deploy` with unique test data. The DEMO seed writes its dev credentials to apps/api/.dev/.

decisions: Business assumption: platform fees are not refunded when a round is cancelled; only stakes go to Owed (matches demo-data: 300.00 refund for 30 entries)
Business assumption: prizes are credited to Owed at settlement and claimed to Available (POST /wallet/owed/claim claims everything owed at once)

Business assumption: a withdrawal to a non-whitelisted or first-time destination goes to under_review with four-eyes approval; 10,000 USDT and above also goes to review; the DEMO sanctions list auto-rejects
Business assumption: KYC level none means no withdrawals (DAILY_WITHDRAWAL_LIMIT none = 0); the KYC check runs before step-up so no 2FA code is wasted
Business assumption: withdrawals stay allowed while self-excluded or abroad (no obstruction); only an admin withdrawals_frozen restriction blocks them
Business assumption: on-chain deposits below the minimum or over an RG deposit limit are still credited (they are the player's funds); limits are enforced on the DEMO simulation only

Prize dust goes to the 1st prize, matching contract DrawMath.splitPool (the @gp/shared prizeBreakdown instead leaves a remainder; identical for 2-decimal pools); when a round has fewer entries than prizes, the 1st prize absorbs the undrawn shares
Locked balance = USER_LOCKED account + the player's attributed stake lines in POOL accounts of open, closed or drawing rounds
DEMO rounds close at their real time but are not drawn unless DEMO_ROUNDS_AUTO_SETTLE=true, so the DEMO balances stay stable
The DEMO seed shifts all demo dates by whole days so round #1,248 closes at the next 20:00 UTC; DEMO_SEED_SHIFT_DAYS=0 keeps the exact snapshot

ds.report:
The apps/web foundation (@gp/web) is built and verified. Typecheck, lint and tests (16) pass, the build has no warnings, and the Playwright screenshots at 1440 and 390 show no horizontal overflow and no console errors. Nothing is committed. I stopped the dev server, so port 3000 is free.

WHAT EXISTS (all under /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web, plus /home/user/Claude/global-pool/docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md)
- Stack: Next 15.5.29 App Router, React 19.3, TypeScript strict (shared tsconfig.base), Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss. Imports order: tailwindcss, then @gp/tokens tokens.css, theme.css, text-styles.css, then tw-animate-css. Also TanStack Query, react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers + zod 4, lucide-react, Radix via the `radix-ui` package, sonner, clsx + tailwind-merge (token-aware `cn`) and cva.
- Fonts work offline: @fontsource-variable/inter and geist (Geist Mono).
- Config files: next.config.ts, eslint.config.mjs (shared createConfig plus Next core-web-vitals, react-hooks and jsx-a11y), postcss.config.mjs, vitest.config.ts, components.json (shadcn). Scripts: dev, build, start, typecheck, lint, test, visual.
- shadcn: the CLI was reachable (`pnpm dlx shadcn@4.23.1 add …`, run under flock). Its generated components were then restyled with the GP tokens. The CLI also installed two packages we don't want (`cn`, `next-themes`); I removed both.
- Auth (src/lib/auth):
  - `useAuth()` returns { mode, status, user, signIn, signUp, signOut, getAccessToken }.
  - Privy is used when NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_APP_ID is set and NEXT_PUBLIC_PRIVY_MOCK is not 'true'. It loads only in that case, offers email, Google, Apple and wallet login, and is set to Arbitrum Sepolia.
  - Otherwise a DEV MOCK dialog runs (email, then any 6-digit code, or wallet) and signs you in as the DEMO user @nova.k.
- Components:
  - src/components/ui: the full primitive set from the brief.
  - src/components/brand: Logo / LogoMark as inline SVG, ChainMark / TokenMark, and GameArt for 10 original games.
  - src/components/domain: Amount, StatCard, BalanceCard, NetworkPill, AddressChip, AmountInput, AddressInput, NetworkSelect, Countdown, JackpotMeter, GameTile.

home.report:
The homepage (PUB-01 at 1440, MOB-03 at 390) is built in apps/web at route / inside the casino shell. It covers all sections H1 to H12, a typed TanStack Query data layer, and four switchable states. Typecheck, lint and tests (35, of which 19 are new) pass, and the build passes both with and without the preview flag. Playwright screenshots of every state at 1440 and 390 show no horizontal overflow and no console errors. Section-by-section side-by-side crops against the reference render are close; the remaining differences are listed below. Nothing is committed and port 3000 is free.

WHAT I BUILT (all under /home/user/Claude/global-pool/apps/web)
- Route: src/app/(app)/page.tsx is a server page. It reads the dev ?state= preview, prefetches every query with prefetchHome() and hydrates HomePage through HydrationBoundary. Its doc comment lists every state.
- Sections in src/components/home/:
  - home-page.tsx: composes the page and holds the state logic.
  - hero.tsx (H1): 3-slide carousel (Global Pool, Orbit Rush Sprint, Daily rewards) with pause and dots; auto-advances every 9 s, pauses on hover/focus and under reduced motion. Gold banner with entry tickets and coin art; side promos (Provably Fair, VIP, Welcome offer, members see Rakeback); Draw card using JackpotMeter and a Countdown to the absolute close time.
  - pool-live.tsx (H2): inline SVG chart (pool-chart.tsx: monotone curve, hover and arrow-key crosshair, screen-reader table), latest entries, draw-threshold meters, per-entry breakdown 10.00 + 0.05 + 0.00 = 10.05, prize-distribution dialog.
  - games.tsx (H3): Originals and Table & live rails, 6 category tiles, licence note.
  - activity.tsx (H4): recent-wins strip with tabs; live-bets table with Latest entries / Big wins / Round history tabs and a rows selector.
  - info-sections.tsx: H5 How it works (5 steps), H6 networks, H8 security.
  - fairness.tsx (H7): explainer, VRF stepper, and a verifier that really recomputes SHA-256 and HMAC-SHA256 in the browser (src/lib/fairness/dice.ts). Editing the client seed or nonce shows a mismatch.
  - programs.tsx: H9 VIP, H10 affiliate with a decimal.js calculator (20% of platform fees).
  - faq.tsx (H11): Radix accordion, support and RG cards, SEO text, Contact and support.
  - H12 is the shell FooterMega.
  - Shared pieces: primitives.tsx, art.tsx, home-context.tsx (useHomeView).
- Data layer, src/lib/data/:
  - types.ts: view models.
  - queries.ts: server-safe query keys, options and prefetchHome.
  - hooks.ts: client hooks, plus useServerNow (clock = server snapshot time + real elapsed time, no fake timers).
  - source.ts: NEXT_PUBLIC_DATA_SOURCE=api switches to the API for /pool/rounds/current, /pool/rounds/:n/feed, /games and /compliance/region. Everything else is mock and marked api: not yet.
  - mock-home.ts: DEMO extras built on @gp/shared/demo, all isDemo true.
- State preview, src/lib/home-preview.ts: /?state=member, restricted, no-round, guest, combinable (e.g. member,no-round). Enabled only in next dev or in builds with NEXT_PUBLIC_STATE_PREVIEW=true. A dev switcher renders at the end of the page when it is on.
- Shell bridge: src/components/shell/shell-overrides.tsx. Pages render ShellOverride (restricted, previewMember, previewGuest); AppShell now reads it.
- States:
  - Guest active round (default).
  - Member: balance pill and Deposit in the top bar, a Your 35 entries pill with about 2.44% odds, entries and available-balance block in the Draw card, Add entries, highlighted You row.
  - Restricted (United States): region banner with Withdraw funds and Restricted countries, Sign up and every gaming or deposit CTA disabled, tiles locked, promotions, activity, categories, VIP and affiliate removed, Region cards (Sign in to withdraw, Close account / self-exclude, Restricted countries), no VPN or bypass hints.
  - No active round: Round 1,248 settled result, countdown to 28 Nov 2026 08:00 UTC, Notify me, winners list, Settled status.
- Mobile 390: everything stacked. Promos, steps, networks, security and VIP tiers become horizontal snap rails. The live-bets table scrolls sideways with a hint line. Mobile top bar and tab bar come from the shell.

EDITS TO EXISTING FILES (additive)
- game-art.tsx: 6 new original art keys (live-pool-roulette, mega-ring-show, baccarat-lounge, speed-twenty-one, sic-bo-triad, dragon-and-phoenix).
- JackpotMeter: unitSize prop.
- Countdown: label prop. This fixes the screen-reader label for opens-in, which used to say Closes in.
- app-shell.tsx: main padding is now top 24 at laptop (matches Figma; was 32) and bottom 64. This applies to every page.
- footer-mega.tsx: 6-column grid without gaps so the community icons fit; link gap 12; logo height 40; Originals names added to the about text.
- visual-qa.mjs: lobby shot names updated.
- package.json: new visual:home script.
- docs/WEB_COMPONENTS.md: Homepage and Data layer sections.
- New QA script: scripts/home-qa.mjs.

REMAINING DIFFERENCES FROM THE REFERENCE RENDER
- Countdown shows 01:15:30, anchored at DEMO_AS_OF 18:44:30 UTC. Figma shows 03:17:42.
- Networks section: Figma shows 5 operational networks. Per owner decision 2, only Arbitrum is live and the other four show Coming soon; the heading reads Deposit USDT on Arbitrum. Step 2 and the SEO copy follow the same rule.
- Affiliate key facts use demo-data.md (12 months tracking; payout in USDT, min 20.00, KYC L2 + 2FA) instead of Figma's 30-day cookie and Monthly, no minimum.
- VIP level-up rewards are described as USDT to Available with no wagering (demo-data and shared DEMO), not bonus funds as in Figma.
- Player counts come from @gp/shared: Live Pool Roulette 412 (Figma 388), Pool Roulette 518 (Figma 212).
- Verifier values differ (hash 9687fca9..., client seed nova-k-7f30fa) so the sample genuinely verifies to roll 73.21.
- While round 1,248 is open, the Draw randomness card shows round 1,247 (DEMO request id 0x4b7e...a913). Figma showed 1,248 as settled, which contradicts an open round.
- Hero and game art are original simplified SVG/HTML. Ticket and coin placement is close but not pixel-exact.
- Relative feed times differ (19 s vs 12 s and so on).
- Page height 10,056 vs 9,685. About 120 px is the dev switcher (absent in the normal build); the rest comes from slightly taller H5, H6 and FAQ blocks.
- At 390, the chart's Min pool 50K label touches the curve.
- The sidebar keeps the LIVE badge in the no-round state.
- Search shortcut shows Ctrl K on Linux instead of the Mac symbol.

NOT VERIFIED
- The API data-source mode was not run against the live API.
- The member state was checked with the dev preview and the shell overrides, not with a real Privy login.
